0.original: Nigen is worried for her husband.

25.original: Use the thick ropes to capture two weakened steppe dzos.

48.original: Hello again! My brother and sister are both doing very well thanks to your aid. There is actually something else I would like you to help me with should you have the time.

49.original: We are a tribe of nomads, periodically dismantling our tents and moving from area to area. Each time we require a group of steppe dzos to transport our homes.

50.original: My husband is currently trying to catch some to the south. He must be struggling otherwise he would have come back by now.

52.original: Please go and help my husband. You will find him to the south.

53.original: Oh, have you come to help? We will take care of this smaller dzo.

54.original: As you look a considerable amount stronger than any of us, could I ask you to catch two of the beasts? Weaken them first, and then tie them up with this rope.

55.original: Would you be able to catch two steppe dzos? Weaken them first, and then tie them up with this rope.

56.original: Were you able to find my husband? I am sure he would appreciate your help.

57.original: You are a natural! Thank you so much.

58.original: I will help guide the dzos back to Mol Iloh. By all means, please head back first. I am sure my wife would like to thank you as well.

60.original: Wonderful to hear. You were not injured by the dzos, were you?

61.original: Capturing the beasts is never easy, but we have little choice. There is no way we alone could ever bear the weight of our tents.

62.original: Please take this for your troubles. Thank you once again.
